rules.description: Bad-habit trainer: numbers ` ⌫ - = ⇥ ] \ arrows ⌃ ⎋ Y H B N => type HERROPERS
Disable Command-C on remapped M key
Map Alt+C to Control+C
Hold M => symbol layer: FOU;=;&$# HAEI=[]() P,.'=:\%?
Hold P => symbol layer: BLDC=^<>| NRTS=+!/= ZXQM=`-*@
Hold S => number layer: FOU=789, HAEI=0123, P,.=456
Hold H => arrow layer: N/R/T/S = arrows; Z/X/Q/M = 5x arrows
Caps Lock / Enter: hold = enable RTSMHAEP hold layers (tap does nothing)
Home-row mods: hold T/A = Left Command, hold R/E = Left Option (physical D/L, S/;)
AeroSpace: alt+J/K/L/; -> alt+h/a/e/i (focus), alt+F -> alt+s (resize -50)
Magic key: [ => the letter that follows the last one typed (p=>y s=>c u=>e r=>l o=>a g=>s w=>s h=>y t=>m l=>m c=>s m=>c y=>p); space forgets, anything else does nothing
Keyboard layout remap: BLDCV (J)JFOU✦[] / NRTSG (Y)YHAEI / XQMWZ (Z)KP,. (right hand shifted right)
MOUSELESS FREE
Map Option+T to Escape
RAYCAST: Change option+A to option+control+command+shift+R
MOUSELESS: Change option+S to option+control+command+shift+c
HOMEROW: Change option+e to command+option+space
Map F3 to Command+Shift+Control+4 (screenshot area to clipboard)
RAYCAST: Map F4 to option+control+command+shift+R
Left Command: tap = Enter, hold = Shift
Right Option: tap = Tab, hold = Left Shift
Map Right Command to Backspace
Left Shift => Z, Right Shift => single quote (no hold behavior)
Left Option => Left Control
F6: Toggle Karabiner profile (disable/enable all mappings)
F6: Toggle Karabiner profile (re-enable all mappings)
